title: commutative-nuclear-square
description: A Heyting algebra A equipped with two commuting nuclei (j_1, j_2): each j_i is a nucleus on A and j_1 ∘ j_2 = j_2 ∘ j_1. Commutativity makes the composite π = j_1 ∘ j_2 itself a nucleus and identifies Fix(π) = Fix(j_1) ∩ Fix(j_2) =: A*. The four corners (A, Fix(j_1), Fix(j_2), A*) form a 2×2 commuting square of Heyting sub-algebras.
